column1: #  - module M and module M = N are packages;
#  - data and record are classes; the fields of a record are fields (every name of `py pz : Nat`);

#  - a function is held once, at its type signature, however many equations follow, and an operator or mixfix function is named as its signature names it (_+++_, if_then_else_); signatures at top level, in a module, or under private, abstract, instance and mutual are functions, and so are the names of a postulate block;
#  - data constructors, pattern synonyms, equations, open/import and let-bound names are not definitions.
